newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB futures end up but off highs ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: JGB futures end up but off highs ahead of weekend.

text.p: Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Friday's Tokyo session up but off their intraday highs, as pre-weekend position-adjustment sales emerged in the last half hour of trade, traders said.
The key March contract closed up 0.11 at 126.39 after rising as high as 126.51.

JGBs received a boost in early morning trade when the Bank of Japan (BOJ) conducted an accommodative money market operation for the first time since August 7, 1996. The BOJ injected 200 billion yen into the market, though only 100 billion yen was needed to cover a shortfall.
